parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they share only the structural shape of being a zero-field type alias — not any actual content or domain meaning. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit) each represent distinct domain events in unrelated subsystems. The `shared_field_count: 1` and `jaccard: null` / `differing_slots: null` confirm the only commonality is the empty-body shape, not any shared fields or logic. Merging or extracting these would conflate unrelated domain concepts and break the semantic clarity of each package's message vocabulary.
